title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
AI Automation Engineer

London (Hybrid - 3 Days per Week)
£70,000 + Benefits

A fast-growing, technology-led organisation is looking for an AI Automation Engineer to help transform how the business operates through intelligent automation and AI-driven workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to join a business investing heavily in data, automation and AI, where you'll work directly with stakeholders across multiple departments to identify inefficiencies, automate manual processes and deliver measurable business value.

The Role

As an AI Automation Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, building and supporting automation solutions that streamline operations, increase productivity and improve accuracy across the business. You'll combine workflow automation, systems integration and generative AI technologies to create scalable solutions that have a tangible impact.

Working closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, you'll evaluate business processes, identify opportunities for automation and implement solutions using modern automation platforms, APIs and AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and map business processes suitable for automation.
  • Design, build and maintain intelligent workflows and automations.
  • Develop AI-powered solutions using large language models (LLMs) and generative AI technologies.
  • Integrate business systems through APIs and automated workflows.
  • Build solutions for document processing, data extraction and workflow orchestration.
  • Implement monitoring, logging and alerting to ensure reliability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.
  • Drive continual improvement of automated processes and AI-enabled services.

Skills & Experience:

  • Workflow automation platform experience
  • Building and supporting production-grade automation solutions.
  • Integrating AI services and LLMs, including technologies such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
  • Strong Python and/or JavaScript development skills.
  • REST APIs, JSON and systems integration.
  • SQL and data handling.
  • Monitoring, troubleshooting and optimising automated workflows.
  • Working closely with stakeholders to deliver business-focused technical solutions.

What's on Offer?

  • Opportunity to shape and influence an emerging AI and automation function.
  • Work on greenfield projects with modern AI technologies.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge automation and agentic AI initiatives.
  • Significant autonomy and ownership from day one.
  • Clear career progression within a rapidly growing technology team.
  • A collaborative environment that values innovation, learning and experimentation.
